label: Badly hidden delight
instruction: Try to sound professionally composed. Let a small trace of inappropriate delight escape near the final important word, then recover. Keep it subtle and keep the words exact.

label: Thin confidence
instruction: Begin with ordinary confidence. Let one brief hesitation or caught breath reveal that maintaining it takes effort, then finish as though nothing happened. Keep the words exact and avoid melodrama.

label: An ordinary Tuesday
instruction: Give a familiar, routine update as someone who has done this many times. Use grounded, matter-of-fact pacing. Avoid mystery, sarcasm, exaggerated warmth and added words.

label: Quiet conviction
instruction: Use sincere warmth and steady conviction. Address one person naturally and directly. Be reassuring without overselling it. Keep the performance restrained and the words exact.
